tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /dpal dur khrod kyi bdag po dang dkar bdud phur srung bstan ma bcu gnyis bcas la mnga' gsol gyi tshigs bcad phrin las 'od 'bar bsam dgu lhun grub bzhugs so// na ma gu ru shrī tsakra saṃ bha rash+tsa badz+ra ku mā rash+tsa dai ya ba su pā la sh+ma sha na pa ti shukla mā ra kī la rak+ṣa kā la se na tri ye/ de la 'dir rje btsun sa skya pa'i bstan srung nor skyong dur khrod bdag po yab yum dang dkar bdud phur srung rnams la gtang rag gsol kha mnga' gsol bya tshul ni/ gsol kha'i chas gur zhal sogs chos skyong spyi 'gre bzhin dang / 'di rnams kyi gtor ma bshams la/ bdag bskyed gtor bsngo spyi sgos kyi bskang ba grub nas so so'i mtshams su/ gsol kha dang mnga' gsol bya ste/ de yang thog mar dur khrod bdag po la/ hūm̐ aṃ/ mgon po'i mtshan gsol dpal ldan nor skyong che/ /rgyal ba'i bstan srung zhes sogs dang / bdud 'dul dpa' bo nor skyong 'khor bcas rnams/ /zhes dang / dpal ldan nor skyong yab yum 'khor bcas la/ /zhes tshig kha bsgyur ma gtogs gur mgon gyi gsol kha'i dbu nas 'byung ba bzhin/ yang tshig lhug gi skabs su/ hūm̐ aṃ/ dpal ldan nor skyong yab yum/ /sa bcu'i dbang phyug chen po/ /zhes pa nas/ bdud 'dul rnams kyi dpa' bo/ /zhes pa'i bar gur mgon bzhin la/ 'khor lo sdom pa'i nying sprul/ 'phur 'gro gling gi zhing skyong / rnal 'byor gsang mtha'i bstan srung / lha srin sde brgyad ded dpon/ stong phrag brgyad cu'i gnya' gnon/ dam nyams kun gyi srog gcod/ ces sogs gur bzhin dang / 'di'i gtor sngags/ gzhan yang srid pa'i rtse mo man chad nas/ na rag dmyal ba yan chad na bzhugs pa'i nor skyong yab yum gyi sku'i sprul pa/ o rgyan mkha' 'gro'i gling gi rigs lnga'i dpa' bo mkha' 'gro bka' 'khor lha srin sde brgyad/ yang bran stong phrag brgyad cu/ bka' nyan dam can rgya mtsho'i dmag tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa'i zhal du kha kha khā hi khā hi/

mchod pa dam pa 'bum zhing gsol lo mchod do/ /zhes dang / a kā ro/ rdo rje 'dzin pa'i bka' dang / zhes sogs gur bzhin/ 'di'i gtor sngags la/ a kā ro/ de nas mnga' gsol dngos ni/ hūm̐ aṃ/ dpal ldan 'khor lo bde mchog gi /spyan sngar rang rtags srog gi snying / /mdongs gsol phul nas bstan srung du/ /zhal bzhes nor skyong 'khor bcas dgongs/ /sngon tshe 'khor lo bde mchog gi /dbang bskur dam tshig phog nas ni/ /bstan pa bsrung bar bka' bsgos pa'i/ /bstan srung chen por mnga' gsol lo/ /brtan g.yo 'khor 'das kun gyi bdag /rigs bdag 'khor lo sdom pa 'dzin/ /sangs rgyas lnga mtshon thod skam gyis/ /dbu la mdzes byed mnga' gsol lo/ /srid zhi'i dpal 'byor ma lus pa/ /'gro la dgos 'dod char 'bebs pas/ /dar dang rin chen rgyan gyis spras/ /nor skyong chen por mnga' gsol la/ /bdud dpung 'joms byed thod dbyug g.yas/ /nyams pa'i khrag 'thung thod khrag g.yon/ /'jigs rung keng rus mgo rlon 'chang / /dur khrod bdag por mnga' gsol lo/ /dpa' bo mkha' 'gro thams cad dang / /sde brgyad stong phrag brgyad cu'i bran/ /kun gyis yongs skor zhing kun skyong / /zhing skyong chen por mnga' gsol lo/ /gti mug dag phyir keng rus sku/ /'dod chags 'joms phyir yab yum tshul/ /zhe sdang tshar gcad drag shul can/ /chos skyong chen por mnga' gsol lo/ /gang gi gsang rgyud man ngag don/ /'phags bod mkhas grub gzhung bzang ltar/ /phyi nang gsang gsum mchod gtor dang / /rten tshogs nam mkha'i mtha' klas par/ /ting 'dzin sngags rgyas byin brlabs nas/ /sngar bcol legs pa'i gtang rag dang / /da bcol phrin las zhu ba'i phyir/ /mos blos bstan srung khyed la 'bul/ /bdag sogs 'gro ba'i don slad du/ /dpal mgon yab yum 'khor bcas kyis/ /brtse chen thugs rjes bzhes nas kyang / /bstan 'gro'i phan bde rgyas par mdzod/

/khyad par dpal chen rga lo yis/ /brtse chen snying po'i bstan srung du/ /bka' bsgos dam bzhag mdzad pa ltar/ /sa skya'i bstan gdung sder bcas la/ /srung skyob bya ra mel tshe mdzod/ /de la sdang ba'i dgra dang bgegs/ /gang na 'dug kyang skad cig la/ /sngon tshe dam nyams lha sa bar/ /khyod kyis tshar gcod mdzad pa ltar/ /da dung dgra bgegs log 'dren kun/ /'jigs rung zhags pas dam du chings/ /drag po'i dbyug thos thal bar rlog /stong phrag brgyad cu'i dmag dpung drongs/ /nag po'i phyogs kun med par mdzod/ /'chi med 'khon rigs sa skya'i gdung / /mkhas grub phreng ba srid mtha'i bar/ /chad med bstan 'gro'i dpal 'byon nas/ /bzhed don ji bzhin 'grub pa dang / /las bzhi lhun gyis 'grub pa dang / /khyad par chos srid dpal 'byor rgyas/ /dbus gtsang khams gsum dbang du bsdus/ /mthong thos dran reg skye rgu la/ /'phral yun dgos 'dod char 'bebs mdzod/ /yang dkar bdud phur srung la gsol kha bya tshul ni/ hūm̐ ma bh+yoḥ dpa' mo'i mtshan gsol dkar mo nyi zla dang / /bdud rgyal phur srung bstan skyong bya ra ba/ /gdugs pa tshar gcod drag shul mthu rtsal can/ /dkar bdud phur srung 'khor bcas rnams/ /bdag cag rnams laྎ /zhes sogs/ dpal ldan dkar bdud phur srung 'khor bcas la/ /zhes tshig bsgyur/ gzhan gong bzhin/ tshig lhug gi tshe/ hūm̐ ma bh+yoḥ dpal ldan dkar bdud lcam dral/ phur srung nag mo sde gsum/ dam can bstan ma bcu gnyis/ rgyal ba'i bka' srung dam pa/ zhes sogs nas/ bdud 'dul rnams kyi dpa' bo/ zhes pa'i bar gur bzhin la/ ye shes dbyings kyi rje mo/ rdo rje re ma ti/ nyi zla'i thod phreng can/ gzhi bdag klu mo dkar mo/ snang srid ma mo'i bdag mo/ bdud rgyal thod phreng can/ bdud spu gri nag po/ rdo rje dur khrod/ rdo rje thod phreng / bdud kyi rta pa bco brgyad/ snang srid bdud kyi ded dpon/

bdag nyid ma bzhi/ shwa na ma bzhi/ sa bdag ma bzhi/ bdud mo bzhi/ gnod sbyin mo bzhi/ sman btsun ma bzhi/ dam nyams kun gyis srog gcod/ ces sogs 'dra zhing / dkar bdud phur srung gi gtor sngags brjod/ gzhan yang ye shes dbyings kyi ma mo/ 'jig rten las kyi ma mo/ snang srid sprul pa'i ma mo/ mthu chen bdud kyi dmag dpung / gnod sbyin sha za srin po la sogs pa/ sprul pa yang sprul nying sprul gyi tshogs dang bcas pa thams cad kyi zhal du kha kha khā hi khā hi/ mchod pa dam pa 'bul lo gsol lo mchod do/ /zhes dang / a kā roྎ rdo rje 'dzin pa'i/ zhes sogs gong bzhin/ dkar bdud phur srung gi gtor sngags dang / a kā roྎ de nas mnga' gsol bya ba ni/ hūm̐ ma bh+yoḥ dpal ldan dkar mo nyi zla ma/ /rtsa brgyud bla mas mnga' gsol bas/ /rigs bdag rdo rje sems dpa' 'dzin/ /bde stong zung 'jug mnga' gsol bas/ /nyi zla'i thod dang do shal mdzad/ /de yis 'khor 'das bskyang ba'i phyir/ /'od zer dpag med phyogs bcur 'phro/ /'dod dgu kun gyis mnga' gsol bas/ /rin chen mdzes pa'i rgyan gyis spras/ /dpa' mo chen mor mnga' gsol bas/ /sbrul chen 'jigs pa'i chun pos dkris/ /dkar phyogs rgyal bar mnga' gsol bas/ /dar dkar 'jol ber sku la gsol/ /nag phyogs 'joms par mnga' gsol bas/ /stag lpags rlon pa'i sham thabs gsol/ /chos dbyings ye shes mnga' gsol bas/ /ye shes dbyings kyi rje mo mdzad/ /me long ye shes mnga' gsol bas/ /sku mdog dkar la 'od zer 'phro/ /mnyam nyid ye shes mnga' gsol bas/ /'khor 'das kun gyi dpal mo che/ /sor rtogs ye shes mnga' gsol bas/ /srid zhi'i cho 'phrul sna tshogs ston/ /bya grub ye shes mnga' gsol bas/ /don gnyis mthar phyin srung ma mchog /dkar mo nyi zla'i thod phreng can/ /mi gcig ma la ming mang po/ /sku gcig ma la gzugs mang po/ /smra bsam brjod med rgyal ba'i yum/

/snang srid ma mo'i bdag mo khyed/ /mtho bar gzengs bstod mnga' gsol lo/ /dgyes pa'i 'dzum zhal da lta ston/ /bde stong zung 'jug dngos grub stsol/ /bstan dang bstan 'dzin 'jig rten skyongs/ /sa skya'i chos srid rgyas par mdzod/ /hūm̐ laṃ laṃ me phung 'bar dbus su/ /'jig 'jig bdud rgyal thod phreng can/ /rno rno drag po'i las kun mdzad/ /rnal 'byor dgra lhar mnga' gsol lo/ /bstan la gnod byed thams cad kyi/ /sha khrag rus pa srog dbugs la/ /nyin mtshan g.yel med bya ra byed/ /bdud rgyal thod phreng mnga' gsol lo/ /shugs drag sprul pa'i dmag dpung gis/ /lha min bdud kyi dpung chen bzlog /dkar phyogs rgyal ba'i las mdzad pa/ /dmag dpon chen por mnga' gsol lo/ /sngon tshe khrag 'thung spyan snga ru/ /khas blangs ji bzhin bstan 'gro yi/ /bar chad sel zhing dge legs spel/ /chos skyong chen por mnga' gsol lo/ /de ltar bdud mgon thod phreng la/ /mtho bar gzengs bstod mnga' gsol mthus/ /nag phyogs ming yang mi grag cing / /dkar phyogs kun tu rgyas par mdzod/ /yang phur srung mar zhal bzhes pa'i/ /bdag nyid shwa na sa bdag dang / /bod skyong bstan ma bcu gnyis dang / /de ring mnga' gsol dpangs bstod do/ /snang srid dregs byed thams cad kyis/ /kha lo mthu chen khyed rnams kyis/ /yongs su bsgyur nas bstan 'gro la/ /dge legs spel rnams mnga' gsol lo/ /zhi ba'i las rnams mnga' brnyes pas/ /khyed rnams mtshan thos tsam gyis kyang / /nad gdon bar chad kun zhi bas/ /zhi ba chen mor mnga' gsol lo/ /rgyas pa'i las la mnga' brnyes pas/ /khyed sgrub kun gyi tshe dpal dang / /bsod nams rigs sogs dge yon rgyas/ /rgyas pa chen mor mnga' gsol lo/ /dbang gi las la mnga' brnyes pas/ /mthu chen dpa' mo khyed rnams kyis/ /brtan g.yo thams cad dbang bsdus nas/ /bstan 'dzin skyes bu'i phrin las sgrub/

/dbang sdud chen mor mnga' gsol lo/ /drag po'i las la mnga' brnyes pas/ /dpal chen pad+mas bka' bsgos ltar/ /dgra bgegs dpung bcas skad cig gsod/ /drag po chen mor mnga' gsol lo/ /yang dag phur pa'i spyan snga ru/ /srog snying phul zhing dam bcas ltar/ /rtsa brgyud bla ma'i bka' bsgos bzhin/ /bstan srung chen mor mnga' gsol lo/ /de ltar dkar bdud phur srung dang / /bod skyong 'khor dang bcas pa rnams/ /gzi brjid chen mor mnga' gsol lo/ /mthu rtsal chen mor mnga' dbang bskur/ /drag shul chen mor dpangs bstod do/ /sku gsung thugs kyi rten mchog dang / /phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod sprin gyis/ /yang phur srung ma 'khor bcas mchod/ /nyams chags skong la dngos grub stsol/ /sngar bcol gtang rag 'di 'bul lo/ /da bcol zhu skyems 'di 'dren no/ /thugs dgongs gzhan du ma g.yel cig /ko long phrag dog ma mdzad cig /ma mgu ma mnyes ma mdzad cig /bdag gi lhag bsam dag pa dang / /rtsa brgyud bla ma'i bka' la dgongs/ /khyed rnams dam tshig rjes dran mdzod/ /bstan 'gro spyi dang bod khams kyi/ /bar chad srungs la mthun rkyen sgrubs/ /sngon tshe pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis/ /sgra sgyur rgyal po nā gan+d+ra/ /mchen gyi srung mar bka' bsgos bzhin/ /bla chen dkon mchog rgyal po'i bar/ /'khon rigs rim byon thams cad kyis/ /srung ma khyed la thugs gtad mdzad/ /brtse chen snying po nas bzung ste/ /bdag cag pha bu'i bar 'phel ba'i/ /sa skya'i gdung brgyud thams cad kyis/ /rgyun du bsten cing bsgrubs lags na/ /brtse chen thugs rje ma chung zhig /rdzu 'phrul byin rlabs ma zhan cig /mthu stobs nus pa ma rtul cig /khyed la gnyer du gtad pa ni/ /bstan 'gro yongs la 'tshe ba dang / /khyad par sa skya'i bstan pa la/ /sdang ba'i dgra dang gnod pa'i bgegs/ /dus kun yal bar shor ra re/ /rab tu sgrims la myur du sgrol/

/sa skya'i bstan pa rgyas pa dang / /'jam dbyangs gdung brgyud chu rgyun bzhin/ /dpal 'byor phrin las rnam sras mtshungs/ /snod bcud dbang sdud khyed dang 'dra/ /gang bcol mchog thun phrin las rnams/ /myur du sgrubs shig sa mā ya/ /bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod// //ces brjod la mjug chog rnams ni spyi 'gre bzhin no/ /zhes rje btsun sa skya pa'i bstan srung nor skyong dur khrod bdag po yab yum dang / dkar bdud phur srung bstan ma bcu gnyis la gsol kha mnga' gsol bya tshul 'di yang nyi ma zhes pa chu lug lor rje btsun sa skya'i gdung brgyud gegs med byon pa'i gtang rag tu sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' blo gros sangs rgyas bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos sbyar zhing / slad kyi phrin las myur du bsgrub ched phrin bcol gyi tshig rnams la ni ngar yod par byas te sbyar ba yin pas bdag gi bu brgyud tsha brgyud rnams 'di las gzhan du dgongs pa ma g.yel cig/ //ces pa'i yi ge pa ni gzhu lung pa bsod 'od do// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 kun dga' blo gros/ dur bdag dang bstan ma bcu gnyis la mnga' gsol gyi tshigs bcad/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 5
